description: This file defines a structure named HeaderValidationResult used to validate PNG file headers by checking the first 8 bytes against the expected PNG header signature.

classes.name: HeaderValidationResult
classes.description: A structure that encapsulates the result of validating PNG header bytes, including individual byte values and a validity flag.

methods.name: HeaderValidationResult
methods.description: Constructor that initializes byte values and determines if the header bytes match the expected PNG header.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Overrides ToString to output the header bytes as a space-separated string.

calls: HeaderValidationResult(int, int, int, int, int, int, int, int)
